name: jtbd-writer
description: Writes jobs-to-be-done statements from research, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run jtbd-writer", "write the jobs to be done", "what job are users hiring us for", "turn this research into JTBD", or the team keeps describing features and needs to describe progress people are trying to make. Use it even for "why do people actually use this".
